themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina’s President Javier Milei faces a sixth consecutive monthly drop in public confidence, hitting a record low of 1.99/5. This decline coincides with escalating internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza, including disputes with Vice President Victoria Villarruel and tensions over judicial scrutiny of key officials like Manuel Adorni.

themes.title: Trump’s Iran deal dominates global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump’s negotiations with Iran have become a focal point for right-wing and far-right media worldwide. The potential deal, which Trump claims will be better than Obama’s, has sparked debates over U.S. foreign policy, the Abraham Accords, and the role of regional allies like Israel and Saudi Arabia.

themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Spain, Italy, and Sweden are advancing policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in areas like housing, education, and social services. These measures, often framed as 'national priority' initiatives, are gaining traction in local and regional governments, sparking debates over their legality and impact on integration.
